title: Coefficient routine runtime bounds
statement: Let a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input have dimension $n>0$, rational accuracy $a/b$ with $a>0$ and $2a\le b$, and Fourier bound $B\ge1$. Write $R$ for its runtime scale, $W$ for the deterministic small-bias construction work at the associated generator parameters, $N$ for the associated sample count, and $L$ for the local Fourier-estimation work over all $n$ coordinates. Then $W\le 2^{138}R^{88}$, $N\le 2^{138}R^{88}$, and $L\le 2^{138}R^{88}$.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Fourier bound is at least one
